clues: This city in Bolivia sits at the foot of a rich mountain. The mountain looks down over the whole city.
It has a rare cold highland climate. Most of the year is dry, then a short wet season comes on strong.
A local man found the rich hill in 1545. His find led to the town being founded and growing fast for its silver.
At one point, this was the second biggest city in the whole world, after London. Its silver made it grow that big.
The Cerro Rico hill and the old town centre are a UNESCO World Heritage Site. That rich hill still looms over the city.
